current.text: Experts disagree on whether he starts. One preview has him tentatively starting as a trusted veteran. The two newest notes expect him not to start, with Wells starting instead, and one preview warns Memphis may go younger and bring him off the bench.
He is not worth even a last-round pick in 10- or 12-team leagues. ESPN's rank near 147 is about right. Yahoo's rank is too low.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace, uses short stints and keeps minutes down. Memphis runs an 11- or 12-man rotation.
Only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward are expected to top 30 minutes, so his minutes are likely capped below that.
His 2P% is expected to come back down to about 48 to 49 percent after last season's jump to 52.
He is a possible trade chip at the deadline. Memphis holds three first-round picks in the 2027 draft, which gives it room to make trades.
He wants another big NBA contract, so one expert expects him to be motivated to prove his value.
Memphis plays 4 games in each of our playoff weeks (19, 20 and 21) with a March 28 end. It has only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He is a scoring-only player. His value comes from points, threes and a good FT%. His rebounds, assists and steals are low for a forward.
FG% is his weakest category and is weak for a forward.
His profile has little room to improve. One expert compares him to Harrison Barnes.
His rim finishing has mostly been in the mid-to-high 50s. His one season at 44 percent looks like the outlier.
He has been much more available than Ja Morant, but he has missed games in March and April before.

note: Grant sits right at the edge of our 144-player pool (Yahoo rank 168, ESPN rank 146, both valued at 0 USD). The newest expert notes doubt he starts, so he is a waiver name, not an auction target. If he does start, he fits a punt FG% build that wants points, threes and FT% from a forward, and Memphis has a 4-4-4 playoff schedule. In the first weeks, check whether he starts over Wells and whether his minutes stay near 30 under Iisalo's short stints.
